name: ak-shopping-markets
description: Myanmar retail, wholesale, inventory and shopping center management app

scripts.copy-web: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const source='apk/app.html';fs.mkdirSync('www',{recursive:true});for(const f of ['firebase-config.js','ak-logo.svg','manifest.webmanifest','sw.js','download.html','USER-GUIDE-MY.md','USER-GUIDE-EN.md','BUSINESS-GUIDE-MY.md','BUSINESS-GUIDE-EN.md','PRINTER-SETUP-MY.md']){if(fs.existsSync(f))fs.copyFileSync(f,path.join('www',f));}if(!fs.existsSync(source))throw new Error('Missing isolated APK source: '+source);const html=fs.readFileSync(source,'utf8');fs.writeFileSync(path.join('www','index.html'),html);fs.writeFileSync(path.join('www','app.html'),html);" && node scripts/copy-zxing.js
scripts.android:sync: npm run copy-web && cap sync android
